Generation Stations
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: Gov-012-r0a
Equipment: Mechanical speed governor
Status: Approved
Issued to: Esna Power Station

This document is carried out in accordance with the inspection and cleaning works on the mechanical speed governor, as per the main equipment outage programme of the station. The first draft of the document was prepared and field-tested by Eng. Abdelsalam Abdelhamid Metwally at Esna Power Station, reviewed by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, approved by Eng. Abdelkarim Moussa Ahmed: Manager of the Mechanical Maintenance Department at the station, endorsed by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali: General Manager of Esna Power Station, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Osama Suleiman Selim: General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and MPIS coordinator.
Issue an approved work permit; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, e.g. wearing a helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Ensure the work area is defined and appropriate warning signs are posted.
Shut down the unit and put it in maintenance mode.
Occupational safety and health and personal protective equipment
Safety pin
Close the inlet and outlet gates
Dewater and dry the unit
Check the oil level in the return oil tank
Check the oil level and the pressure value in the governor cylinder
Check the governor oil cooling circuit filter
Check the governor group filter
Check the no-load valve of each pump
Check the safety valve of the oil circuit of each pump separately
Check the governor group of the guide vanes
Check the governor group of the runner blades
